cc:Work.dc:title: Solidify angular kinetic fit sensitivity
cc:Work.dc:description: Solid-side finite-range kinetic intercepts on the physical lattice; markers use the registered quadratic fit at V = 0.005, 0.01, 0.02. Bars show the full intercept range across the registered linear, primary quadratic, secondary quadratic and cubic methods; they are fit sensitivity, not statistical confidence intervals. V = 0.04 is held out from the primary fit and enters only the registered secondary/cubic sensitivity fits. Unit width, P.tau = 1, identity grain; [321] is the held-out orientation. These finite-range diagnostics establish no exact zero-speed coefficient, temporal stability, production adoption or Q3 acceptance.

g.text: Oblique kinetic correction: registered fit sensitivity
Markers: primary quadratic at V = 0.005, 0.01, 0.02; V = 0.04 held out from that fit.
Bars: full range of four registered intercept methods; fit sensitivity, not confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 8.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #42474d

g.text: Unit width, P.tau = 1, identity grain. Finite-range diagnostics; no exact zero-speed, stability or adoption claim.
